t: 英国国王詹姆斯一世的第二个英格兰议会,即所谓的"加分议会",开幕.
te: The second English Parliament of king James I, the so-called Addled Parliament, opens.
dz: 英国国王詹姆斯一世的第二个英格兰议会,即所谓的"加分议会",开幕.
de: The second English Parliament of king James I, the so-called Addled Parliament, opens.

t: 在弗吉尼亚州,美洲原住民宝佳康蒂与英国殖民者约翰·罗尔夫结婚.
te: In Virginia, Native American Pocahontas marries English colonist John Rolfe.
dz: 在弗吉尼亚州,美洲原住民宝佳康蒂与英国殖民者约翰·罗尔夫结婚.
de: In Virginia, Native American Pocahontas marries English colonist John Rolfe.

t: 英国詹姆斯一世的第二届议会在两个月的僵局后结束,没有通过任何法案.
te: The second parliament of James I of England ends after two months of deadlock and without passing any bills.
dz: 英国詹姆斯一世的第二届议会在两个月的僵局后结束,没有通过任何法案.
de: The second parliament of James I of England ends after two months of deadlock and without passing any bills.

t: 马耳他东南部和热吉通镇遭受奥斯曼军队的袭击。这是奥斯曼帝国最后一次征服马耳他岛的失败尝试。
te: The south east of Malta, and the town of Żejtun, suffer a raid from Ottoman forces. This was the last unsuccessful atte…
dz: 袭击热吉通：马耳他东南部和热吉通镇遭受奥斯曼军队的袭击。这是奥斯曼帝国最后一次征服马耳他岛的失败尝试。
de: Raid on Żejtun: The south east of Malta, and the town of Żejtun, suffer a raid from Ottoman forces. This was the last unsuccessful attempt by the Ottomans to conquer the island of Malta.

t: 犹太人被从神圣罗马帝国法兰克福驱逐出,此前犹德干加斯被掠夺.
te: Jews are expelled from Frankfurt, Holy Roman Empire, following the plundering of the Judengasse.
dz: 费特米尔克起义:犹太人被从神圣罗马帝国法兰克福驱逐出,此前犹德干加斯被掠夺.
de: Fettmilch uprising: Jews are expelled from Frankfurt, Holy Roman Empire, following the plundering of the Judengasse.

t: 新荷兰公司向荷兰总督申请在现在的美国东北部地区的独家贸易权。
te: The New Netherland Company applies to the States General of the Netherlands for exclusive trading rights in what is now…
dz: 新荷兰公司向荷兰总督申请在现在的美国东北部地区的独家贸易权。
de: The New Netherland Company applies to the States General of the Netherlands for exclusive trading rights in what is now the northeastern United States.

t: 日本Dam Justo Takayama因信奉基督教被德川一一枪放逐到菲律宾.
te: Japanese daimyō Dom Justo Takayama is exiled to the Philippines by shōgun Tokugawa Ieyasu for being Christian.
dz: 日本Dam Justo Takayama因信奉基督教被德川一一枪放逐到菲律宾.
de: Japanese daimyō Dom Justo Takayama is exiled to the Philippines by shōgun Tokugawa Ieyasu for being Christian.
